note: Byte-identical copies of public files from the canonical WalletWall repository, read only when WALLETWALL_SOURCE_ROOT is not set. Each copy is bound to its git blob id and re-verified on every read; none is an independent source of truth. Live staleness detection always runs against a real WalletWall checkout.

docs/concepts/migration-readiness.mdx.role: Source page of the migration-readiness video, published at https://docs.walletwall.org/concepts/migration-readiness.

docs/docs.json.role: Docs-site navigation: decides which pages are published, their URLs, and their navigation groups.

docs/.mintignore.reason: Lists internal, unpublished material, so it is not mirrored into a public repository. At this blob it excluded no existing navigation page file, which `npm run contracts:check` re-verifies against a checkout.
